scenes.title: One fleet. Many devices.
scenes.subtitle: Your software, across the devices you manage.
scenes.text: SuiFleet manages software updates across connected devices. Publish a release, deploy it to selected devices, and track installation results. Organize devices into groups to manage rollouts across your fleet.

scenes.title: You approve the changes.
scenes.subtitle: A wallet is your approval app.
scenes.text: Your wallet is your secure approval app. Use it to authorize fleet management changes. The network verifies your approval, and each device uses its own identity. Your wallet's private key stays in your wallet.

scenes.title: Publish once. Choose who can read it.
scenes.subtitle: Release records and software files have different jobs.
scenes.text: Release details are recorded on Sui, the shared network. Walrus stores the software files for the retention period you select. Private releases are encrypted, and Seal checks who may obtain the keys. Publishing makes a release available for deployment; installation is a separate step.

scenes.title: Devices check for their updates.
scenes.subtitle: The device initiates the connection.
scenes.text: Choose a device or group and approve its deployment. Each device client checks the shared records for updates on its configured schedule. Devices initiate these connections from your network, using outbound requests.

scenes.title: Download. Verify. Install.
scenes.subtitle: Your platform controls the installer and reboot.
scenes.text: An eligible device downloads the software, verifies it against the approved release, and runs your configured installer. Your platform controls system installation, reboot and recovery. Devices that reconnect later can retrieve an update while the deployment remains eligible and the files are available.

scenes.title: A request is not a result.
scenes.subtitle: Requested → Applied. Health is a separate report.
scenes.text: Each device reports whether installation succeeded or failed. The console displays those results alongside separately reported device health. An approved deployment confirms your intent; the device's installation result confirms execution. Health reports describe its condition at the time of the sample.

scenes.title: Approve. Check. Verify. Report.
scenes.subtitle: Start small. Expand with confidence.
scenes.text: SuiFleet connects your console, shared release records, software storage and device clients. Begin with a small group, validate your deployment process, and expand through staged rollouts. Reliable connectivity, storage availability and a funded network budget keep the system operating.
